meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 它把一份 DAG 定义存成 JSON 文件,之后按名字加载并运行,不用每次重贴整张图。加载时自动填充 {{key}}、{{date}} 等占位符,并把 key 换成带时间戳的新值。
howto.when: 当你提到保存 DAG、运行已保存的 DAG 等需求,或想反复调度同一张多智能体图时接管。

say.text: 把这个图存成 nightly-audit,以后按名字跑
say.note: 写入 $HOME/.omo/dags/ 并试跑一次确认
加载并运行,key 自动带 UTC 时间戳
key 固定为该后缀,可幂等复用

howto.what_en: It saves a DAG definition as a JSON file and later loads and runs it by name, so you don't re-paste the graph each time. On load it fills placeholders like {{key}} and {{date}} and rotates the key with a timestamp.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to save a DAG, run a saved DAG, or repeatedly schedule the same multi-agent graph.

say_en.text: Save this graph as nightly-audit so I can run it by name later.
say_en.note: Writes the JSON into the dags dir and runs it once.
Loads and starts; the key gets a UTC timestamp.
A fixed suffix keeps the key idempotent.
